status: Proposed bounded dependency-patch trial; not a ratified dependency exception or evidence of S4 completion
owner_direction: Owner supports bounded modifications subject to existing budgets, scope and licensing safeguards. Exact package exception remains to be recorded under PM029 before any vendoring or dependency mutation.
purpose: Resolve private font selection/loading/cache and raster construction admission under AC-05, HP08-03, MEM-STAGING-LOCAL and MEM-STAGING-TOTAL.
finding: Glyphon reexports the relevant types. A glyphon-only modification cannot control the observed FontSystem, Swash ScaleContext or Zeno AdaptiveStorage growth. Accounting accessors alone cannot enforce construction-time ceilings.
excluded_changes: No glyphon patch: existing reexports suffice for inherent methods on the underlying types.
No package version upgrades, new transitive dependencies, network build steps or changes to other third-party packages.
No resource-cap increase, scope reduction, text omission, raster-quality reduction, terminal-emulator change, backend-default change or resize investigation.
patch_contract: Add an opt-in fallible font preparation path that admits cache growth and construction overlap before mutation and propagates budget refusal distinctly from a missing font. Preserve original font identity, fallback and shaping output.

Add an opt-in fallible raster path that admits outline, hinting, raster scratch and output growth before allocation. Propagate refusal through cosmic-text to Datum without silently substituting missing glyphs.
Budget permits must cover retained storage until release and temporary old/new overlap. Existing Datum host/process owners supply authority; do not create competing independent caps.
Keep existing entry points for compatibility; Datum production consumers must use the bounded path. Merely adding unused APIs is not completion.

Treat nested allocation paths in unmodified libraries as unresolved until a justified pre-call bound covers them. A measured peak, arbitrary reservation, post-call eviction, allocator abort or unwind is not the required safe admission mechanism.

licensing_boundary.selected_option_proposed: MIT for each specifically named package; preserve complete package license files and applicable copyright notices in sources and distribution notices.
licensing_boundary.limits: Package-level MIT offers do not establish clearance for every transitive dependency, embedded font or other asset. No change to existing license policy and no whole-project legal assurance.

go_no_go.first_integrated_proof: One font preparation plus raster path must refuse before exceeding the existing host/process budget, retain source text, retry successfully after capacity is released, and preserve glyph pixels. Cover cold construction and existing-cache growth with concurrent-owner reservations.
go_no_go.stop_boundary: If correct admission requires modifying another package, bypassing existing budgets, a broad algorithm replacement or unsafe allocation-failure recovery, do not expand the exception or integrate a partial bounded path. Report the concrete additional boundary.
go_no_go.known_risk: Font::new calls HarfRust ShaperData/ShaperInstance construction; Swash uses Skrifa outline/hinting internals. This review does not establish bounds for those calls. The proposed trial is not a promise that three patches suffice.
go_no_go.completion: Only after the integrated proof succeeds, migrate all existing shared text consumers, retire competing unbounded production entry points, run affected renderer/app and native proof, and review all S4 implementation obligations. Original full qualification remains S5.

authority_required: An explicit numbered owner decision naming these versions, accepted MIT obligations and this stop boundary, with PM029 DA-007 same-change records, before modified third-party source or Cargo overrides enter the repository.
work_performed: Read-only local source and license inspection; no copied or modified dependency source, downloads, Cargo changes, production edits or new benchmarks.
